title: Should Have Been a Statistic
coreMove: Separate what happened to you from the authority it still claims over your next move.
sourcePressure: The source centers on Buffalo, Trunnis Goggins, forced night work at a skating rink and nightclub, fear at home, escape with Jackie to Brazil, Indiana, and the refusal to let real damage become destiny.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer must not turn a violent childhood into a tidy resilience origin story where hardship automatically produces strength.

hook: A child should have been a statistic
counterintuition: Your past does not define you
tryThisNow: Look in the mirror and tell yourself the truth
examples: therapy breakthrough in a quiet office

exampleSpecs.domain: county survivor benefits office processing an old violence file
exampleSpecs.audience: an adult claimant whose history is real but whose next form cannot be filled out by rage alone
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the claim stalls because the file becomes identity instead of evidence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the claimant slides the stamped police report into the evidence tray, then writes one next action on the intake checklist without softening what happened
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a torn manila file pressed flat under a scratched plexiglass window

exampleSpecs.domain: night janitorial crew orientation at an airport terminal
exampleSpecs.audience: a supervisor training a teenager who is exhausted from a chaotic home
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether fatigue becomes an excuse for unsafe shortcuts around locked gates
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the supervisor points to the sealed gate log, names the exhaustion as real, and still makes the trainee sign the safety sequence before the shift starts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a yellow gate log clipped to a rolling supply cart under fluorescent light

exampleSpecs.domain: public library adult literacy desk after a housing move
exampleSpecs.audience: a new resident carrying shame from a disrupted childhood
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether past instability keeps him from entering the reading program he needs
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he writes the old address on the registration card, crosses it out once, and copies the new tutoring time without apologizing for either address
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a blue library card with one address crossed through in pen

exampleSpecs.domain: community boxing gym first weigh-in for a young fighter
exampleSpecs.audience: a coach working with a fighter whose home chaos follows him into training
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether anger becomes a permanent alibi for missing basic drills
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coach lets the fighter name the chaos, then taps the taped drill card and waits until he completes the first round exactly
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a taped drill card curling at the corner of a heavy bag

exampleSpecs.domain: tenant legal clinic preparing a move-out packet
exampleSpecs.audience: a volunteer helping someone leave a dangerous household
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether escape is framed as the finish line rather than the start of hard rebuilding
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: after the emergency order is copied, the volunteer opens the benefits packet and circles the first appointment because safety did not solve rent
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a photocopied emergency order warming on the copier tray

exampleSpecs.domain: rural apprentice mechanic rebuilding after foster placement
exampleSpecs.audience: a foreman deciding whether to excuse missed steps or teach accountability
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether compassion becomes lowered expectations that trap the apprentice
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the foreman reads the placement note, folds it once, and has the apprentice torque each lug nut again to the printed spec
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a torque chart taped beside a dented wheel rim

skillTargets: distinguish explanation from excuse in a concrete hardship case
choose the next accountable action after naming real damage
evaluate when compassion has become lowered standards

tryThisNowSpec: Write one hard fact from your past as evidence, then write one present-tense action beside it that the fact does not get to cancel today.
